title: Checksums, fixed values and terminators (YAML surface)
description: @checksum crc32(a .. b) covers from field a to field b; an integer @fixed on an i32 is typed xsd:int and a hex @fixed stays xsd:hexBinary; @terminator gives the terminator bytes. The YAML mirror compiles to the same graph. An unquoted 0x89504E47 is a hex byte string, as @fixed 0x89504E47 is in text.
